questions.notes: This is the first truthful rotational vertical slice, not a supplemental analysis. IMPLEMENTED at M11-A4 as the INTERNAL_ONLY paladin-retribution-observed-decisions analyzer (src/specs/paladin/retribution/), under the class/spec authority boundary (racials, potions, item uses and external buffs are outside the rotational decision domain; race and faction are not read) and the exact-zero buff-stack binding. Production result over the committed A7R6 actor-6 bundle (165 s): 69 eligible spender decisions, 1 MATCH (Final Verdict at +104,407 ms), 10 REJECTED (unselectability; two also scan-selected), 58 UNKNOWN with the stopping entry named; gtKb actor 23 opener (20 s): 15 eligible, all UNKNOWN. The A3 hand audit's 6 MATCH / 2 scan-REJECTED counted race worlds and positive stack assumptions the implementation does not make. PUBLIC at M11-A5: the same analyzer, unchanged, is reachable through the application service, REST, MCP and raid-night for a Paladin/Retribution identity; the in-domain casts outside the spender slice project as the spec-neutral public exclusion reason OUTSIDE_SUPPORTED_SLICE (the one additive analysis/1 vocabulary change of the promotion). Still no supplemental analysis: the other questions below are unchanged.

questions.question: Were Bone Shield stacks maintained (pinned lines read buff.bone_shield.stack and .remains)?
unknownConditions: buff.bone_shield.remains bound since M11-B4 at 115 of 123 decisions (11 exact, 104 lower-bounded past a refresh of unpinned cause); the exact stack count at 114 of 123 (M11-B2)
run_action_list dispatch (modelled since M11-B1; measured on this list in M11-B2)
questions.notes: M11-B2 measured the pinned San'layn lists: every scan stopped at the first entry of its list on the decimal literal 1.5 the shared parser then refused. M11-B3 admitted decimals (syntax only): the first undecided GCD candidate became buff.bone_shield.remains at 96 of 123 and buff.essence_of_the_blood_queen.remains at 24. M11-B4 derived both remainders (Bone Shield 30 s exact or lower-bounded past a refresh of unpinned cause, Essence 25 s exact) under the 50 ms pre-decision window: 21 of 123 resolve (all Death Strike MATCH, 0 REJECTED); the first undecided candidate became runic_power.deficit at sanlayn[2] (43), buff.blood_debt.stack at sanlayn[7] (15) and the window-refused Essence/Bone Shield entries (25 / 7). M11-B5 carried Runic Power (exact from the latest read state under continuity, or a lower bound on the deficit when the cast's own Heartbreaker gain sits 0-1 ms ahead): 25 of 123 resolve (21 Death Strike + 4 Blood Boil MATCH, 0 REJECTED); the first undecided candidate became buff.blood_debt.stack at sanlayn[7] (45), the Essence window refusals (25), Bone Shield window refusals (7) and Death Strike usability (4). M11-B6 read Blood Debt's count from its own transitions (the last applybuffstack's absolute count, the pinned 1 of a fresh plain application, zero from a removal; an application to a held aura refuses): 37 of 123 resolve (27 Death Strike + 6 Heart Strike + 4 Blood Boil MATCH, 0 REJECTED); the first undecided candidate is now fight_remains at sanlayn[9] (20), Marrowrend usability at sanlayn[7] (16, the count exactly 10 and no rune proof), the Essence window refusals (25) and Bone Shield window refusals (7); 41 scans still block at sanlayn[10] consumption.
